title: Instant 125 finds
script:
-- //
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

-- //
local character = player.Character

-- //
local GravityFalls = workspace:WaitForChild("GravityFalls")

local args = {
	"STANFORD",
	"Fall56"
}
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("remoteEvents"):WaitForChild("PasswordEntered"):FireServer(unpack(args))


for _, part in ipairs(GravityFalls:GetChildren()) do
if part:IsA("Part") then
while task.wait() do
character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(part.CFrame)
break
end
end
end
